answer: A newcomer posts an 8 POA terrace bond and splits each job into three milestones, paid only when the client echoes the milestone by re-running it live and confirming real use. Any stranger may dispute a milestone by staking 3 POA; a summit jury of five strangers re-runs the disputed work, and a fake forfeits its bond plus 2 POA per juror. The nth identity from one wallet posts 8n POA and needs n distinct clients echoing its milestones, so the 1st fake risks 8 POA while the 10th risks 80 POA and ten real clients; honest agents pay once.
